criteria: Uses avoir and être accurately, including j'ai [age] ans
Chooses possessive adjectives by the gender of the noun owned
Agrees adjectives correctly in gender and number
Uses topic vocabulary for family, friendship and relationships accurately
S01_Identity_Relationships_Core.pass_threshold: Foundation: names family/friends and describes them with correct avoir/être, possessives and basic agreement (grade 3-5). Higher: extends description with a wider adjective range and no agreement slips.

criteria: Uses singular reflexive verbs correctly, especially s'entendre avec

(Higher) Links clauses with que correctly, distinguishing it from qui
S02_Identity_Relationships_Extended.pass_threshold: Foundation: uses singular reflexives and one negative form correctly (grade 4-5). Higher: adds plural reflexives and que confidently in extended sentences.

source.document: AQA GCSE French (8652) specification, Theme 1 Topic 1 and Section 3.2 grammar

criteria: Uses du/de la/des/de l' correctly, including the switch to de after a negative

Uses topic vocabulary for food, exercise, sleep and risk behaviours accurately
S03_Healthy_Living_Core.pass_threshold: Foundation: gives basic health advice using il faut and a partitive article correctly (grade 3-5). Higher: uses modal verbs fluently across several health contexts.

(Higher) Uses en and depuis + present tense correctly
S04_Healthy_Living_Extended.pass_threshold: Foundation: forms basic commands and routine reflexives correctly (grade 4-5). Higher: uses all three Higher structures accurately in a connected paragraph about lifestyle change.

(Higher) Uses the conditional and a superlative accurately, and depuis + present correctly
S06_Education_Work_Extended.pass_threshold: Foundation: compares two subjects and states an ambition (grade 4-5). Higher: uses the simple future, conditional and superlatives fluently to discuss ambitions and preferences.

Uses jouer à, jouer de and faire de accurately with the correct contraction

Uses topic vocabulary for hobbies and leisure accurately
S07_Free_Time_Core.pass_threshold: Foundation: describes hobbies with correct jouer/faire and one accurate past-tense choice (grade 4-5). Higher: contrasts habitual and one-off events confidently.

(Higher) Uses depuis + present tense accurately, not the perfect

Uses ne...plus and/or ne...que accurately

Produces a dictation that is both meaningful and accurately spelled, including endings and accents
Translates French into natural, accurate English, keeping every tense and detail
Avoids common false friends and literal mistranslation
S19_Listening_and_Reading_Papers.pass_threshold: Foundation: answers most comprehension questions correctly and produces a recognisable dictation/translation with some errors (grade 4-5). Higher: near-complete accuracy on comprehension, dictation and translation, including detail and nuance.

criteria: Gives a clear, comprehensible message for every role-play task
Reads aloud with recognisable pronunciation and answers the follow-up questions accurately
Develops photo description with detail, opinion and personal link, not just description
Sustains the unprepared conversation with genuine, spontaneous responses
S20_Speaking_Paper.pass_threshold: Foundation: completes all three tasks with a clear message and adequate pronunciation (grade 4-5). Higher: sustains a longer, more spontaneous conversation with developed answers and secure pronunciation.

criteria: Covers every bullet point in structured tasks before worrying about extra accuracy
Produces an accurate gap-fill, including correct accents and word forms
Translates in both directions keeping tense and meaning, element by element
(Higher) Uses at least two to three time frames and justified, nuanced opinions in the extended/open tasks
S21_Writing_Paper.pass_threshold: Foundation: covers every bullet point across all Foundation tasks with recognisable structures and few gap-fill errors (grade 4-5). Higher: covers every bullet with two to three time frames, justified opinions and accurate translation.

source.document: AQA GCSE French (8652) specification, Scheme of assessment (Paper 4 Writing) and sample assessment material mark schemes
source.reference: AQA 8652 specification, scheme of assessment

criteria: Listening and Reading: answers capture the specific detail asked, and the dictation/translation are both meaningful and accurate
Speaking: every task gives a clear, comprehensible message; the photo task is developed with detail, opinion and personal link
Writing: every bullet point is covered before extra accuracy is credited; gap-fill and translation are precise, element by element
Grammar: tense choice (present/perfect/imperfect/near future, and at Higher, future/conditional/passive/relative clauses) is consistently correct, not just occasionally correct
Range: vocabulary and structures are drawn from at least two different themes, showing the course's coverage rather than one memorised topic
exam_rubric.pass_threshold: All four simulated papers show secure, consistent performance at the learner's tier, with every bullet/task covered and no persistent tense or agreement errors.

source_notes: AQA's own subject-content pages list themes and topics but do not itemise vocabulary or grammar points with individual reference codes below topic level, unlike AQA's science specifications (which use numbered subject-content codes such as 4.1.1.1); this course's item ids are therefore an invented, stable scheme (AQA-FR-T<theme>.<topic>-<slug>[-F|-H], AQA-FR-P<paper>-<taskslug>), stated here and in each item's own context.

AQA's 8652 sample assessment material mark schemes (Version 1.0, Listening/Speaking/Reading/Writing) were used in the prior build for task-type detail; the live 2026 series papers and mark schemes sit behind AQA's secure site and were not resolved in this rebuild.
